title: The Road to Stock Market Participation
eligible_reason: Binary absorbing treatment connect (pincode connected by a PMGSY rural road; staggered completion dates 2004-2015 at the pincode-month level) estimated by static TWFE with pincode FE, year-month FE and district x year FE (time-invariant characteristic x time, allowed), no controls or weights, clustered by pincode. 38 static columns across Tables 2, 3A, 3B, 5B, 7A, 8, 9A, 9B, 10 use connect alone; 4 unstacked TWFE event studies (14_figures.do) add relative-year dummies. Household (CMIE) and bank-branch (RBI) panels use hh + month and branch + year FE respectively.
design_notes: Stata. 13_reg_final.do runs all tables on NSE_data_final.dta (pincode x month; 592k obs, 4,154 pincodes; 'connect' mean 0.553), CMIE_consumption.dta (Table 7) and Bank_Deposit.dta (Table 8). 14_figures.do runs event studies on NSE_data_annual.dta. results_NSE.log contains the full esttab output for Tables 2-10 (coefficients, SEs, N), from which published_estimates were taken. Outcomes are logs of trade counts / investor counts (L-prefixed) or levels of profits, returns, durations. Tables 4, 5A, 6A, 6B, 7B are moderator interactions (ineligible). README: data merged at pincode-month; roads matched to pincodes within 5 km; first completed road defines connectivity timing.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not computable (data absent). Road completions are monthly over 2004-2015, so dozens of monthly cohorts are implied; the README mentions 'staggered rollout'. Whether never-connected pincodes are in the sample is not stated (connect mean 0.553 across pincode-months).

specs.reported_location: Table 4; Table 5 Panel A; Table 6 Panels A-B; Table 7 Panel B

data_access: proprietary (NSE trading data under data-sharing agreement; RBI branch and deposit data restricted; CMIE commercial); public inputs: PMGSY/SHRUG roads, night lights, rainfall, Census
replication_feasible: no (no data in package; would require NSE/RBI access via authors)
screener_notes: Package contains only 13_reg_final.do, 14_figures.do, results_NSE.log and MNSC-readme.pdf; master.do and data-cleaning scripts referenced in the README are not included. Full text has Borusyak/Callaway/Sun-Abraham/de Chaisemartin flags, so the paper may report heterogeneity-robust estimators in an appendix not covered by the package. Flag: the event-study reference category is ambiguous from code.
